# S0102: nbtstat

<a id="s0102"></a>

Type: tool  
ATT&CK: [S0102](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0102)  

[nbtstat](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0102) is a utility used to troubleshoot NetBIOS name resolution.
